attchmntText: Reliance Power Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Reliance Power Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Authorization to determine materiality of information and disclosures to the Stock Exchanges'.
voiceSummary: Reliance Power Limited has authorized Key Managerial Personnel to determine the materiality of information and make disclosures to stock exchanges under SEBI Listing Regulations. The authorized individuals are Executive Director and Chief Executive Officer Neeraj Parakh, Chief Financial Officer Rajendra Vishwanath Pawar, and Company Secretary Ramandeep Kaur. Their contact details are available on the company website. This notice is filed with BSE and NSE for record.

attchmntText: Reliance Power Limited has informed the Exchange about change in Management
voiceSummary: Reliance Power Limited approved its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 12, 2026. The Board appointed Shri Rajendra Vishwanath Pawar as Chief Financial Officer with immediate effect. Shri Neeraj Parakh resigned as Interim Chief Financial Officer on the same date. Statutory auditors issued qualified conclusions on the consolidated results. Auditors of Rajasthan Sun Technique Energy Private Limited noted a net loss of Rs. 11,952 lakhs and a negative net worth of Rs. 2,72,954 lakhs, citing material uncertainty regarding going concern. Auditors of Samalkot Power Limited reported a net loss of Rs. 6,231 lakhs and a negative net worth of Rs. 2,89,415 lakhs, with borrowings of Rs. 1,89,239 lakhs in default. Auditors of Dhursar Solar Power Private Limited could not verify the carrying value of Property, Plant and Equipment worth Rs. 32,154 lakhs or the recoverability of Rs. 28,880 lakhs in receivables from Reliance Infrastructure Limited.
